letter books, planning registers and warrant books, ledgers, harbour cash books and other papers 1853-1975 (AS/BMcd) Bristol Record Office Charles Goodland (1812-1893), sailor: manuscript account of voyages with transcript 1829-1954 (45349) Cornwall Record Office Fox family of Falmouth: family and business records for GC Fox, shipping brokers 1663-2004 (FOX) Gilbert family of Trelissick: journal of Grace Gilbert on a voyage from Falmouth to Barbados and Antigua aboard Montagu Packet ship 1822 (AD2330) Cornwall Fisheries Advisory Committee: minutes 1996 (AD1657) Cumbria Archive and Local Studies Centre, Barrow Vickers-Armstrongs Ltd, aircraft and armaments manufacturers, shipbuilders and engineers: additional Barrow-in-Furness shipbuilding order and offset books 1925-1971 (BDX 697) Dudley Archives and Local History Service William John Resson (fl 1940-1960), Officer RN: naval service record, photographs and postcards 1940-1960 (Acc 9792) Dundee City Archives Dundee, Perth & London Shipping Co Ltd: additional records incl minute books, accounts and records of subsidiary companies 1879-1985 (GD/DPL) East Riding of Yorkshire Archives and Local Studies Service GD Holmes Ltd, carriers, barge, tug and keel owners, Goole: shipping records 1910-1968 (DDX1949) Thomas and William Harrison, ship carpenters, Beverley: keel repairs account books, cash book and workers' time log 1863-1950 (DDX1978) East Sussex Record Office George Murray Levick (1876-1956), Surgeon Commander: additional photographs and papers, with letters to his future father-in-law, Mayson Beeton 1880-1974 (Acc 12001, Acc 12065) Glamorgan Archives Royal Hamadryad Seaman's Hospital, Cardiff: patient deposits book 1903-1952 (D1204) Gwynedd Archives, Caernarfon Record Office HMS Glendower, Second World War naval camp: cookery training ledger 1945 (XM13105) Highland Archives: Lochaber Archive Centre Cnoc Breac Collection: Moidart salt sales register, records rel to Loch Shiel Royal Mail service incl log books of SS Clanranald II [transferred from West Highland Museum] 1902-1919 (L/D162) Hull History Centre (Hull City Archives) Peter Warren (fl 1938-1944), Merchant Navy cadet: account of Second World War experiences, with associated letters 1938-1944 (C DIWA) Hull Steam Trawling Mutual Insurance & Protecting Co Ltd: records 20th cent (C DMM) Huntingdonshire Archives Oliver Cromwell (1599-1658), Lord Protector: letter to the Admiralty and Navy officers authorising issue of twelve barrels of powder to Sir John Reynolds 1657 (5743) Isle of Wight Record Office Charles Vine (b 1876), merchant seaman: career papers incl testimonials 1900-1931 (2014/109) Lincolnshire Archives Clapson & Sons, shipbuilders and repairers, Barton upon Humber: records incl job sheets for vessels built, financial records and deeds 17th-20th cent (CLAPSON) Norfolk Record Office National Coastwatch Institution, Mundesley Station: log books 1999-2014 (ACC 2014/277) Northumberland Archives Blyth Tall Ship Oral History Project: interviews rel to working life in and around the Port of Blyth 2013-2014 (T/924-T/936) Blyth Harbour Wind Farm Project, Wansbeck: records incl environmental statements, statistics and photographs 2007 (NRO 10600) Craster Coastg
